zh: 我不太擅长闲聊。
en: I'm not very good at {small talk}.

zh: 我昨天在城里碰到了一位老朋友。
en: I bumped into an {old friend} in town yesterday.

zh: 她从小学起就是我最好的朋友。
en: She's been my {best friend|best mate} since primary school.

zh: 你周六来参加我的生日派对吗？
en: Are you coming to my {birthday party} on Saturday?

zh: 他给我留下了很好的第一印象。
en: He made a good {first impression} on me.

zh: 我们是通过一个共同的朋友认识的。
en: We met through a {mutual friend}.

zh: 搬进去以后我们要办一个乔迁派对。
en: We're having a {housewarming party|house-warming party|housewarming} after we move in.

zh: 我把你加进我们的群聊。
en: I'll add you to our {group chat}.

zh: 一个朋友给我安排了一次相亲（事先没见过面的约会）。
en: A friend set me up on a {blind date}.

zh: 每年圣诞节我们都有一次大型家庭聚会。
en: We have a big {family gathering|family get-together|family reunion} every Christmas.

zh: 他说完以后，出现了一阵尴尬的沉默。
en: There was an {awkward silence|uncomfortable silence} after he spoke.

zh: 我在新西兰只有几个亲密的朋友。
en: I only have a few {close friends|good friends} in New Zealand.

zh: 她很有幽默感。
en: She has a great {sense of humour|sense of humor}.

zh: 我们背景不同，但还是找到了很多共同点。
en: We come from different backgrounds, but we found a lot of {common ground}.

zh: 周五我们办百乐餐，每个人带一道菜。
en: We're having a {potluck dinner|pot luck dinner|potluck} on Friday, so everyone brings a dish.

zh: 他们邀请我们周六去他们家参加晚宴。
en: They've invited us to a {dinner party} at their place on Saturday.

zh: 下个月是我父母结婚三十周年纪念日。
en: Next month is my parents' thirtieth {wedding anniversary}.

zh: 很多青少年是因为同伴压力才开始抽烟的。
en: A lot of teenagers start smoking because of {peer pressure}.

zh: 从他的肢体语言能看出他很紧张。
en: You could tell from his {body language} that he was nervous.

zh: 演讲时要和听众保持眼神交流。
en: Keep {eye contact} with the audience when you give a speech.

zh: 我加入头马俱乐部是为了练习公众演讲。
en: I joined Toastmasters to practise {public speaking}.

zh: 我不怎么在社交媒体上发东西。
en: I don't post much on {social media}.

zh: 我每周给父母打一次电话。
en: I give my parents a {phone call|call|ring} once a week.

zh: 那是只有我们俩才懂的内部玩笑。
en: That's an {inside joke|in-joke|private joke} between the two of us.

zh: 我今晚不想出去，只想在家安静地待一晚。
en: I don't feel like going out tonight. I just want a {quiet night in|quiet night}.

zh: 周五下班后我们有同事酒会。
en: We've got {work drinks|after-work drinks|after work drinks} on Friday.

zh: 他风趣又健谈，是个很好的伴儿。
en: He's funny and easy to talk to, so he's really {good company|great company}.

zh: 他们谈了两年的异地恋。
en: They were in a {long-distance relationship|long distance relationship} for two years.

zh: 她是我们家多年的老朋友。
en: She's an old {family friend}.

zh: 上周五我们和同事晚上出去玩得很开心。
en: We had a great {night out} with my workmates last Friday.
